name: Customer Onboarding Packet (Fontara, Inc.)
summary: Two documents in one envelope — the service level agreement and the Acceptable Use Policy. The customer fills both and signs both, Fontara signs the SLA, Fontara Legal gets a copy. Reminders after 2 days then every 3; expires in 30 days with a warning 5 days before; the account brand, locked.
emailBlurb: Please complete your details in both documents and sign.
